evidence: Two kinds of ALD-sns x films grown at 160 °C and 180 °C are investigated systematically by X-ray diffractometry, Raman spectroscopy, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). The XRD patterns of SnSx-180 showed sharp peaks consistent with the orthorhombic structure of SnS. The Raman spectra of all the SnSx samples showed distinguishable peaks. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) measurements were carried out. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images were recorded. The electrochemical measurements were conducted in a three-electrode system using cyclic voltammetry (CV), galvanostatic charge/discharge investigations, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS).
